label: Listening 1 — My picture
lines: Listening one. My picture. True or false?
This is my picture. There is a small house, and there is a cat in the garden. The cat is black.
In the kitchen there is a table. On the table there is a red apple.
There is an umbrella by the door, because it is a rainy day.
And look, there is a boy at the window. The boy is my son, Harry. He is seven years old.

label: Listening 2 — My pets
lines: Listening two. My pets. Listen and complete.
Hi! I love animals, and I have got lots of pets.
I have got a dog. The dog is called Rex. He is big and brown.
I have got a cat, too. The cat is white, so her name is Snow.
And I have got two fish. The fish are orange and very small.
Oh, and there is a white rabbit in the garden. The rabbit is not my rabbit. It is my friend's rabbit.

label: Listening 3 — At the café
lines: Listening three. At the café. Circle the right answer.
Good morning! What would you like?
Hello. Can I have an orange juice, please?
Sure. The orange juice is two pounds.
And I would like a sandwich, please. An egg sandwich.
OK. The egg sandwich is four pounds.
Great. Oh, and can I have an apple, please? It's for later.
Of course. Here you are. The apple is free today!
